summary: Technical system architecture for an Autonomous Code Review and Security Remediation platform. The architecture ingests filtered pull request webhooks, isolates relevant AST diffs to minimize token overhead, prompts an LLM for targeted security/performance patches, verifies candidates inside warm ephemeral test sandboxes, GPG-signs validated patches, and publishes suggested commits to VCS alongside an immutable audit trail requiring explicit human approval.

nodes.label: GitHub / GitLab Platform
nodes.description: Source control system hosting repositories, triggering PR events, and receiving review comments and suggested commits.

nodes.label: Webhook Ingestion Gateway
nodes.description: Validates cryptographic webhook signatures and filters events, rejecting draft PRs and only queueing 'ready_for_review' actions.

nodes.label: AST Diff & Semantic Parser
nodes.description: Extracts syntactic code diffs, stripping irrelevant noise and isolating relevant AST subtrees to reduce token consumption by up to 80%.

nodes.label: Remediation Task Queue
nodes.description: Distributed queue (e.g., AWS SQS or Redis Streams) managing asynchronous review and test validation jobs.

nodes.label: Remediation Orchestration Engine
nodes.description: Coordinates LLM inference, sandbox test execution loops, commit assembly, and validation gating.

nodes.label: Secure LLM Gateway
nodes.description: Enterprise model interface performing static vulnerability detection, N+1 detection, and patch synthesis with strict data-retention boundaries.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Test Sandbox Pool
nodes.description: Snapshot-cached microVM/container environment (e.g., Firecracker / Docker) that checks out patches and executes the repo test suite.

nodes.label: GPG Commit Signing Service
nodes.description: Internal HSM or key management module that cryptographically signs approved bot commits prior to git publication.

nodes.label: Append-Only Audit Vault
nodes.description: Immutable datastore recording original diffs, LLM prompts, sandbox execution traces, and cryptographic commit hashes for SOC2 compliance.

nodes.label: Engineering Human-in-the-Loop
nodes.description: Mandatory developer approval boundary; reviews contextual explanations, diffs, and benchmark metrics to manually approve/merge.

edges.label: Test suite exit code & perf metrics
Persist run log, diff, and provenance

mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
  subgraph VCS [Version Control & Humans]
    vcs_platform[GitHub / GitLab Platform]
    human_reviewer[Human Engineer / Reviewer]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion [Ingestion & Token Optimization]
    webhook_gateway[Webhook Ingestion Gateway]
    ast_diff_engine[AST Diff & Semantic Parser]
    job_queue[(Remediation Task Queue)]
  end

  subgraph Core [Remediation Engine]
    remediation_orchestrator[Remediation Orchestration Engine]
    llm_inference[Secure LLM Gateway]
    sandbox_runner[Ephemeral Test Sandbox Pool]
    gpg_signing_service[GPG Commit Signing Service]
  end

  subgraph Compliance [Security & Audit]
    audit_vault[(Append-Only Audit Vault)]
  end

  vcs_platform -->|PR ready_for_review| webhook_gateway
  webhook_gateway -->|Raw PR diff| ast_diff_engine
  ast_diff_engine -->|Filtered AST chunks| job_queue
  job_queue -->|Pop job| remediation_orchestrator
  remediation_orchestrator -->|AST prompt| llm_inference
  llm_inference -->|Candidate patch| remediation_orchestrator
  remediation_orchestrator -->|Run test suite| sandbox_runner
  sandbox_runner -->|Pass/Fail + Metrics| remediation_orchestrator
  remediation_orchestrator -->|Sign verified patch| gpg_signing_service
  gpg_signing_service -->|GPG-signed commit| remediation_orchestrator
  remediation_orchestrator -->|Write run trace| audit_vault
  remediation_orchestrator -->|Push suggested commit| vcs_platform
  vcs_platform -->|Review patch & report| human_reviewer
  human_reviewer -->|Manual merge| vcs_platform
  vcs_platform -.->|Audit merge event| audit_vault
